name: KRC v0.2 — Warranted Korean Clause Game, Typed Critic Witnesses & Bounded Repair
purpose: Test whether a typed, clause-local generator and separate witness-producing critic can form two-paragraph Korean passages without monolithic decoder leaking instructions or inventing source facts.
scientific_hypothesis: Local source-fact realization with fixed bounded critic feedback and deterministic paragraph assembly has a greater mechanical chance of paragraph correctness and source-anchored phrases than the v0.1 monolithic planner. It does not by itself establish naturalness.

mathematical_contract.source: Γ=(F,U,C,D) licensed facts, explicit unknowns, situation and discourse order
mathematical_contract.generator: G(Γ,slot,feedback) proposes one Korean clause and declared fact-id; cannot revise Γ or select new facts
mathematical_contract.critic: V(Γ,slot,candidate) returns typed counterexample witnesses, never a scalar realism discriminator
mathematical_contract.game: For each slot, at most 2 generator proposals (one initial, one witness-conditioned repair); if neither passes mechanical invariants use exact source-fact fallback; deterministic composer concatenates slots into exactly two paragraphs
mathematical_contract.no_true_GAN_claim: No differentiable discriminator, backpropagated gradients, model weight updates or adversarial training; GAN-inspired bounded inference-time proposer-critic game only
mathematical_contract.primary_unit: Fact-carrying clause, not approval of generic revision or guessing model identity
mathematical_contract.evidence_proofs: Only exact source atom fallback proves literal custody. Lexical anchor presence in model-generated clause is necessary weak evidence, never a semantic fidelity guarantee.

runtime.language: Node.js 22 orchestration and deterministic witness critic + C++ llama.cpp runner
runtime.input: All fact atoms available as context. Slot includes one source fact and its place in discourse.
runtime.feedback_prompt: Only witnessed failures and original source fact, never evaluator-generated replacement text or aesthetic points
runtime.original_source_authority: Never alter briefs or facts following result

evaluations.round0: Typed validity by slot, excluding unsupported numeric/categorical facts from source
evaluations.round1: Same typed validity after one witness-conditioned repair if round0 inadmissible
evaluations.fall_back: Exact verbatim original fact clause, labeled SOURCE_LITERAL_FALLBACK, not rewritten as model success
evaluations.text_audit: 2-paragraph compliance, all slots represented, fallback rate, suspicious lexical flags, no human quality estimates
evaluations.reader: HOLD — user will recruit readers using prior v0.1 blind materials independently
evaluations.comparison_to_v01: Descriptive and task-mismatched (new briefs): cannot claim causal improvement of grammar or Korean naturalness

prohibitions: No scalar discriminator or 'AI humanlike' detector
No judge authority promotion from regex cues
No third iteration regardless of outcome
No hidden reference or historical 24 PIA access
stop: At most 2×5 slots×2 requests; stop after one bounded run, preserve all raw candidates in limited research artifact, no post-result prompt tuning.
